beats.text: The village is rattled. Everyone's jumpy — eyes on the treeline.

A tiger feeds the village for a week. The pelt is beyond price; the claws are trade and talisman both. It's dead. The carcass is there on the ground — search the body if you want the meat. But you don't know this flesh.
The Static stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
🧳 A traveler swears The Red Table, southwest, is feasting — a whole elk, they say. (They're wrong. The Red Table is starving.)
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. You went to bed on an empty stomach.
★ IDENTIFIED: Kudzu Root. Kudzu. A tangle of vines swallowing the treeline. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
